website.title: nwmpublisher: Garry's Mod Workshop publisher and downloader
website.description: A free app for uploading Garry's Mod addons to the Steam Workshop, and for downloading and opening other people's addons. Based on gmpublisher, for Windows, macOS and Linux.
website.heading: nwmpublisher
website.intro: A free app for uploading your Garry's Mod addons to the Steam Workshop, and for downloading and opening other people's addons. No command line needed.
website.platforms: Windows, macOS and Linux · Free and open source

website.how_intro: Keep Steam open and signed in while you use it.
website.how_publish_1: Click Publish New and choose your addon's folder.
website.how_publish_2: Check the list of files that will go in. nwmpublisher tells you if Garry's Mod won't accept one.
website.how_publish_3: Add a title, description and icon, then click Publish. Updating it later works the same way.
website.how_download_1: Search the Workshop in Browse, or paste Workshop links into the Downloader.
website.how_download_2: Subscribe to use an addon in game, or download it to keep its files.
website.how_download_3: Open any addon to see what's inside, and copy its models, sounds and code into a normal folder.
website.compare_intro: nwmpublisher started as a copy of gmpublisher and still does everything it does. It installs next to gmpublisher, so you can keep both, and the first time it runs it can import your gmpublisher settings.
website.compare_watermark: Adds “Uploaded with gmpublisher” to new addons
website.feature_publish_body: Format descriptions and changelogs with Steam's formatting tags (BBCode) and see how they'll look on Steam as you type. Paste Markdown, import your README or CHANGELOG, or start from a template.
website.feature_manage_body: Change visibility and required addons without uploading your files again, and see subscribers, favourites and votes for each of your addons.
website.feature_collections_body: Make, edit and compare collections. See which items are missing, removed or listed twice, and subscribe to or download a whole collection at once.
website.feature_browse_body: Search the whole Workshop and filter by type and tag. Subscribe, download or add items to collections, and get offered any required items you're missing.
website.feature_clean_body: Open any installed addon or .gma file (the file type Garry's Mod uses for addons), preview its images, textures, sounds and videos, and extract it to a folder. See which addons use the most disk space, and clear out files left behind by addons you've unsubscribed from.
website.download_intro: Choose the download for your computer.
website.load_error: Could not load downloads. Open GitHub Releases below to get the latest version.
website.install_windows: Run the installer. It installs separately from gmpublisher and offers to import your gmpublisher settings on first launch.
website.install_windows_portable: Portable: extract the ZIP and run nwmpublisher.exe. It shares settings with the installed app and requires Microsoft WebView2 Runtime.
website.install_macos: Open the disk image and drag nwmpublisher into Applications. If macOS blocks it, allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security after the first launch attempt.
website.install_linux: Install the package for your distribution, or allow the AppImage to run as a program in its file properties. On Steam Deck, use Desktop Mode.
website.steam_note: Keep Steam running and signed in for Workshop features.
website.nightly_intro: Built each night from the newest changes, when there are any. It may have bugs. It installs alongside the stable app and keeps its own settings.
